description: This file defines the class SqlServerStorageForTesting which extends RelationalStorageForTesting to provide SQL Server-specific setup for testing, including database creation, deletion, and test table creation.

classes.name: SqlServerStorageForTesting
classes.description: A class providing SQL Server-specific testing utilities such as database creation, deletion, and query execution

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the storage with a connection string and sets the provider moniker
